_doc: Gap closures of the agentPane fixture family (scripts/cmux-next/oracle/action_fixtures/agent_pane.py, p15-oracle-085). `closed`: ids that leave every-action-gaps.json `gaps` (p15-oracle-087 applies this file), each with why. `reasoned`: ids that stay gaps, each with the reason the gap keeps. action_fixtures.load_families refuses a `closed` that is not the family's CLOSES.

closed.agentPane.archiveChat: the sweep's chat context holds before the describe: Sweep.described waits for agentPaneFocused (focus_composer if it is late); the handler archives the focused mock chat
closed.agentPane.git.commit: the sweep's chat context holds before the describe (Sweep.described); the handler opens the changes view's commit form on the mock chat's repository (mockGit.ts)
closed.agentPane.permission.allowChat: the sweep's chat context holds before the describe (Sweep.described); the handler sends the page's permission command
closed.agentPane.permission.refresh: the sweep's chat context holds before the describe (Sweep.described); the handler sends the page's permission command
closed.agentPane.previousTurn: the sweep's chat context holds before the describe (Sweep.described); the handler steps the mock chat's transcript

reasoned.agentPane.createCheckpoint: the checkpointCaptureAvailable fixture (agent_pane.CheckpointCapture) runs, but the fact never holds: the chat page reads checkpoint support from the native host's git.capabilities, which AgentPageOps does not serve (AgentPageProvider.swift), so AgentTabs.publishCheckpointAvailability never sets it. It closes when the host serves git.capabilities and git.checkpoint.* (an app follow-up).
